reviews.t: HP Printer Back On-Line with this purchase
reviews.x: Product arrived on-time and well packaged.  Installed the Magenta cartridge in my HP OfficeJet Pro L7590 and the printer handled it just fine. Received TWO  Large Black cartridges with the shipment (1 Yellow, 1 Cyan & 1 Magenta) - All for a Phenomenal Price. I had quit using this printer because of the Cost of Replacement cartridges. Happy to have the L7590 back on-line.

Gotta love it! My OfficeJet Pro L7590 recognized these refilled cartridges without any problems! Well,only one - It did not recognize them as XL cartridges, but it did give them an expiration date in 2019.  I will gladly purchase my next set of cartridges from this supplier! Thank you!

reviews.t: 1st one leaked. Second one ruined the printhead.
reviews.x: Just received these a couple days ago. Installed the 1st Black cartridge as I was running out of black. The 1st of the 2 black cartridges included would not seat properly and leaked inside the printer. The second installed just fine but was not printing well. So, I ran the printhead cleaning utility a few times but each time it would get worse and now the black does not print at all and I am getting an error message that I need to replace the black/yellow printhead. reviews.t: Worked Great With My HP Officejet Pro L7580
reviews.x: These ink cartridges work well with my Officejet Pro L7580.  With other brands I have experienced short lived cartridges or worse the printer will not recognize the ink cartridge and refuse to print.  I did not have either of these problems so far and I have done a fair amount of printing.  I read all the reviews before purchasing and knew that it was possible to have a bad experience.  But at this price versus "genuine" HP, I could afford to take a chance and if it did not work try anot

reviews.t: It's ink. It works. Looks like OEM ink at a fraction of the price.
reviews.x: Not much to say other than printed material looks good coming out and our printer accepts the ink just fine.  I've only done printing on standard 8.5"x11" paper with simple color logos and graphics (like what you'd see on a Amazon order receipt). Not sure how high fidelity color photos on glossy paper would look, but a consumer printer will never compare to the commercial printers at photo places.  I've had the ink installed for several months now and even with infrequent printing it has

Kit contained 2 black XL cartridges, one didn't work and the other printed out nicely appx 12 pages of my tax return and from there all I got was blank pages with a few light lines. Tried all my maintainence (cleaning and alignment of prt heads, still same results.) Color cartridges in kit seem ok.

reviews.t: I was a little reluctant to try these but now ...
reviews.x: I was a little reluctant to try these but now I am sold after long term use and on my third set with no problems.

reviews.t: Have been working great for over a year
reviews.x: Bought set of ink carts for HP Officejet Pro L7600.  Just the sales tax on a full set of original ink carts would have been about the same amount of money. Have been working great for  over a year.  They could fail right now and it would have been a screaming deal.  Given how old the printer is now, it could fail at any time.  Its way beyond its designed lifetime. So, I figured, why spend big bucks for carts? It was at least worth trying the alternatives.  Sounds like a small percentage of the c

Was initially happy with this, the cartridges worked and printed a few pages. Two days later the black cartridge was reported as malfunctioning, next the yellow cartridge was reported as full, but no yellow would print. Cleaned printer heads, aligned carts, restarted printer, nothing worked. One cartridge had black spots and rust on it. Not quality replacement cartridges.

Bought the Limeink ink pack to replace my original HP 88 ink cartridges. All four colors inserted easily and print great. I have a smart all in one printer. It reads these cartridges as genuine hp products on the printer when I installed them. It's a great deal compare to the HP ink cartridges. I highly recommend it.

My HP L7580 recognized these were not HP cartridges and behaved as if these cartridges were trying to destroy it.  It would not perform any print or copy functions.  It constantly flashed every warning light while simultaneously reminding me that I had voided my warranty. Limeink cartridges were a BAD choice.

It unfortunate i ordered these before i actually needed tham. I order because of the price and i was order ink for another printer. Finally needed these and the cartridge stabilizer on the end of that has the chip is missing. Needless to say if it does not keep contact it says it is missing or empty.

I'm always wary of remanufactured ink, but my printer is pretty old and these priced really well - so I thought I'd take the chance. They seem to work every bit as well as the HP version - the color is good, I cannot vouch for the number of pages but it seems pretty comparable. I'm pleased.

reviews.t: Perfect retrofit for my HP printer
reviews.x: Perfect retrofit for my HP printer.  Brief instructions would be helpful as I wasn't sure if clear plastic seal over the ink nozzle was to be removed (it isn't, leave it there), but installed on printer with no error messages, tested some prints, and all is well at a very good price!

reviews.t: Dependable, No Problem, Quality Printer Ink
reviews.x: This Limeink is the second ink pack that i have ordered. The first complete set is in my OLD K5400 inkjet printer. I ordered this second set After inserting my last cartridge. I have not had any problems at all by using this Limeink and that is why I ordered more.

Ink cartridges came on time and the black cartridge was immediately recognized as an authentic HP cartridge. Prints well, I will purchase again. I did have to clean the print head several times to keep smudges from appearing.

Ordered b4 needed... Now installed and neither black cartridges work..  Past the return window!!! This SUCKS!!! Now I have to buy at the office supply store and they are closed till tomorrow!! Really NOT HAPPY!!!

Installed each cartridge into the printer, the printer alerted me that ink levels were low. Attempted to print after shaking and reinstalling each cartridge, however blank pages printed. Will not order again.

colors are way off and HP printer immediately knew they were 3rd party and magenta lasted 2 pages before printer said it was empty and wouldn't print at all. Lesson learned...just get price gouged by HP.

reviews.t: Good printing but didn't as long as I had hoped
reviews.x: Didn't last near as long as an original HP standard size. Printing was very good, just didn't last near as long as I had hoped but I didn't pay as much as an HP cartridge either.
I just received these cartridges and had a little trouble with the magenta cartridge but I finally got it to work.  Hopefully, they will last as a long as the HP cartridges.
I'm super pleased with this purchase, particularly that my HP Officejet L7680 did not flag the cartridges as not being authentic and the quality is fine for my purposes.
Just not like the real thing.  The yellow cartridge was not recognized by my printer, no matter how hard I tried.  And now it's leaking.  Will not buy again.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the cartridges work well and are recognized by their HP OfficeJet printers, often at a much lower price than OEM ink.
Several reviewers experienced cartridges that leaked, malfunctioned, or stopped working shortly after installation.
Some reviewers report their printers did not recognize the cartridges as genuine HP or refused to print.
A few reviewers complain about poor packaging and missing instructions.
Some reviewers note long-term reliability, using multiple sets over a year without problems.
